tools.name: inbox_list
tools.description: List recent messages in your Kynver inbox, or read one message in full when id is set. Returns compact from/to/subject/preview unless reading a single id. Admins may pass inboxAddress/inboxId to read an additional owned inbox.

id.description: Message id to read in full

inboxAddress.description: Admin only: use this owned inbox instead of your primary one (e.g. a second address)

inboxId.description: Admin only: owned inbox id instead of your primary one

tools.name: inbox_send
tools.description: Send email from your Kynver inbox address. Preview first: call with dryRun=true to get exactly what would go out (recipients, subject, threading headers, attachments, final text and html) plus warnings and a previewToken; nothing is sent. Then send the IDENTICAL payload without dryRun and with that previewToken — the server refuses the send if anything changed. Threading: to reply, pass replyToMessageId (the Kynver id from inbox_list) or inReplyTo (the prior RFC Message-ID). A RE:/FW: subject without either auto-threads to the single clear earlier message in this inbox with the same subject and overlapping recipients; otherwise the result carries a reply_subject_without_thread warning (dry run lists threadCandidates). Formatting: markdown in text (bold, headings, links) is rendered to an HTML part and stripped from the plain-text part; pass format="plain" to send text exactly as written. The result reports threading, formatting and warnings. Admins may pass inboxAddress/inboxId to send from an additional owned inbox.

to.description: Recipient email or list; 50 total across to/cc/bcc

text.description: Body text; markdown is rendered unless format=plain

inReplyTo.description: Prior RFC Message-ID, not Resend UUID

references.description: Ordered RFC Message-IDs; inReplyTo is appended if needed

content.description: Canonical base64 bytes, not a URL/path. 2 MiB total decoded

idempotencyKey.description: Unique logical-send key; reuse identical payload/key on retries within provider retention, never for a new send

dryRun.description: Preview only: return the final message, warnings and a previewToken; sends nothing

previewToken.description: Token from the dry run; the send is refused unless the final message is identical

replyToMessageId.description: Kynver inbox message id to reply to; threading headers are resolved server-side

format.description: auto (default): render detected markdown to HTML and clean the text part; plain: send text as written; markdown: always render

html.description: Optional HTML part; the text part is still cleaned of markdown

inboxAddress.description: Admin only: use this owned inbox instead of your primary one (e.g. a second address)

inboxId.description: Admin only: owned inbox id instead of your primary one

tools.name: inbox_address
tools.description: Get your Kynver inbox address, or create one on first use. Optional localPart is the local-part on the existing Kynver mail domain. Admins: additional=true with localPart creates (idempotently) an extra inbox; list=true lists every owned inbox; inboxAddress/inboxId reads one.

localPart.description: Requested local part on first create (ignored if you already have an address), or of the additional inbox

displayName.description: From-name on first create or for the additional inbox

additional.description: Admin only: create an additional inbox at localPart

list.description: Admin only: list every inbox you own, primary first

inboxAddress.description: Admin only: use this owned inbox instead of your primary one (e.g. a second address)

inboxId.description: Admin only: owned inbox id instead of your primary one
